title: Newtonian gravitational force
references: Goldstein, H., Poole, C. and Safko, J., Classical Mechanics, 3rd ed., Addison-Wesley (2002)
CODATA 2022 recommended value of the Newtonian constant of gravitation G, https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?bg
validity_domain: Force between two point masses or spherically symmetric bodies at centre distance r, weak field and speeds much below c.
limitations: An approximation of general relativity: not valid near compact objects or for precision orbital work
r is the distance between centres; for non-spherical bodies the formula is approximate
The uncertainty of G (CODATA 2022) is propagated by the engine, apart from the tolerance
